title: Hera Pheri
description: Three unemployed men find the answer to all their money problems when they receive a call from a kidnapper. However, things do not go as planned.
stars: Akshay Kumar, Sunil Shetty, Paresh Rawal

title: Chup Chup Ke
description: A man in debt fakes his death to save his family, but ends up in a house where everyone thinks he is deaf and mute.
stars: Shahid Kapoor, Kareena Kapoor, Paresh Rawal

title: Pyaar Ka Punchnama
description: Three bachelors find girls who they fall in love with. However, the twists and turns of their newly developing love stories soon become a nightmare.
stars: Kartik Aaryan, Divyendu Sharma, Raayo S. Bakhirta

title: Pyaar Ka Punchnama 2
description: Three friends experience the pitfalls of love and relationships. Just like the prequel, it takes a comic look at the downside of modern romance.
stars: Kartik Aaryan, Sunny Singh, Omkar Kapoor

title: Stree
description: The people of Chanderi live under constant fear of Stree, the spirit of a woman who attacks men at night during festivals. Vicky, along with his friends, decides to unravel the mystery.
stars: Rajkummar Rao, Shraddha Kapoor, Pankaj Tripathi

title: Bhediya
description: Bhaskar finds himself changing after being bitten by a wolf in the forests of Arunachal. While Bhaskar begins to transform into a shape-shifting werewolf, he and his friends look for answers amid many twists, turns and laughs.
stars: Varun Dhawan, Kriti Sanon, Abhishek Banerjee

title: Munjya
tagline: The legend of the bride-seeking spirit.
description: A young man's visit to his native village unveils a family secret and a vengeful spirit, the Munjya, who wants to get married.
stars: Abhay Verma, Sharvari Wagh, Mona Singh

title: Stree 2
description: The town of Chanderi is being haunted again. This time, women are mysteriously abducted by a terrifying headless entity known as Sarkata.
stars: Rajkummar Rao, Shraddha Kapoor, Pankaj Tripathi

title: Thaama
tagline: The next chapter in the supernatural universe.
description: A highly anticipated horror-comedy set to expand the Maddock Supernatural Universe with a brand-new folklore and terrifying laughs.

title: Shakti Shalini
description: Another exciting addition to the universe, featuring an untold story of a powerful entity from Indian folklore.

title: Bhediya 2
description: Bhaskar returns as the werewolf protector of the forest, facing a newer and darker threat that tests his humanity and animal instincts.

title: Stree 3
description: The epic continuation of the Chanderi saga. Stree's myth deepens as the town faces its most ancient evil yet.

title: Chamunda
description: A fierce exploration of local legends, bringing the dreaded Chamunda into the shared universe.

title: Maha Munjya
description: The Munjya spirit returns, but this time the stakes are massive, tying the events across the universe.

title: Pehla Mahayudh
description: The Avengers-style team-up of the Maddock Universe. Stree, Bhediya, Munjya and more unite for the first Great War against darkness.
stars: Rajkummar Rao, Varun Dhawan, Shraddha Kapoor

title: Doosara Mahayudh
description: The conclusive battle of the horror-comedy universe. The fate of the mortal realm hangs in the balance.
